retrieved_chunks_summary.page_content: Hans Frank remained head of the General Government until its collapse in early 1945. Hans Frank joined the Hitler Cabinet as Reich Minister without portfolio in 1933. Hans Michael Frank served as head of the General Government in Poland during the Second World War. Hans Frank had lost Hitler's favour by 1942. Hans Frank was found guilty of war crimes at the Nuremberg trials after the war. Hans Frank became the lawyer of the NSDAP. Hans Michael Frank was a German politician. Hans Frank was sentenced to death. Hans Frank took part in the failed Beer Hall Putsch. Hans Frank was found guilty of crimes against humanity at the Nuremberg trials after the war. The policies of enslavement and extermination used by Hans Frank were later used extensively in conquered territories of the Soviet Union. Hans Frank instituted a reign of terror against the civilian population during his tenure as Governor-General. Hans Frank was appointed Governor-General of the occupied Polish territories after the German invasion of Poland in 1939. Hans Frank was an early member of the German Workers' Party. Hans Frank oversaw four of the extermination camps during his tenure as Governor-General. Hans Frank became directly involved in the mass murder of Jews during his tenure as Governor-General. Hans Frank became Adolf Hitler's personal legal adviser. Hans Frank engaged in the use of forced labour during his tenure as Governor-General.
